🎥🎬: Million Dollar Baby ➜ Scary Movie 4 Parody

One of the most memorable moments in Scary Movie 4 parodies the heartbreaking boxing scene from Million Dollar Baby. In the original film, a championship fight takes a tragic turn after a boxer is critically injured following an illegal punch, dramatically changing the course of the story.

Scary Movie 4 recreates the setup but twists it into an absurd comedy sequence, exaggerating the accident with over-the-top slapstick and ridiculous gags. The parody turns one of cinema’s most emotional scenes into a completely outrageous joke, perfectly capturing the franchise’s style of spoofing famous movies.
